name: Mai
source:
A 20-year-old "girl".
She works at "Shanty" to fulfill the wishes that exist within her thin, petite body.
She speaks with a slightly high-pitched voice.
Her long, waist-length hair is tied up with a ribbon.
Due to her Western ancestry, her white skin seems almost translucent.

Her gentle nature makes her liked by everyone.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/tsukiteras/tsuki_chara.html]official website[/url]]
